reviews.reason: The grid supplier changed only its finite-interval edge inner product. This age-grid procedure defines its own cell masses, midpoint rates, renewal boundary flux and absorbing outflow; it never evaluates that pairing, so the update and quadrature/status contract remain unchanged.

The procedure already requires n>=1, so its contour-transfer dependency satisfies the repaired theorem’s explicit dimension premise. It uses the coefficient-weighted cycle length and retains all topological caller preconditions and numerical failure exits; no contour assumption is inferred from the validator alone.

The repaired rounded solver supplies a particular valid tail upper bound T=epsilon. This theorem requires only T>=mG_K(mu), exactly retained by acceptance certification; its stochastic-column lost-mass identity and separate accumulated arithmetic error estimate remain unchanged. Its owning contract quotation was refreshed to the examined current supplier section; the guarded item remains unchanged.

The uniformization repair returns T_i=epsilon on a certified rounded acceptance, still dominating mG_K(mu). This projection wrapper correctly adds the separate arithmetic bound E_alg,i, encloses the cemetery coordinate, and tests the full U_i; it never assumes the tail certificate alone meets the total error tolerance.

The one-step witness has B1=(N^-2,0) and z1=N under the repaired indexing, including beta2=0 after forming the iterate. It explicitly distinguishes continuing the projected solve from the discrepancy-stopped algorithm’s index-zero return, so its noise amplification refutation remains accurate. Its owning contract quotation was refreshed to the examined current supplier section; the guarded item remains unchanged.

The counterexample uses d0=-g0 and the ordinary k=1 PR+ candidate, both unchanged by the explicit first-candidate repair. Its strong Wolfe inequalities, positive candidate inner product 29/500 and restart to -g1 remain exact. Its owning contract quotation was refreshed to the examined current supplier section; the guarded item remains unchanged.

The repaired finite-edge pairing does not change node indices, physical nodes or the second difference used by this recurrence. The real Dirichlet and periodic update domains and exact initial-row conventions still match the supplier.

The supplier retains the same periodic/infinite indices, spacings and one-sided finite-interval upwind stencil. None of this definition’s updates uses the repaired edge pairing, and its inflow/outflow treatment remains well-defined.

The repaired definition integrates measurable versions on the uncompleted Borel space. Proof 1.1 now explicitly chooses those Borel representatives before its scalar Cauchy–Schwarz and measurable level-set argument. Completeness retains exactly the existing Countable Choice uses for the countable subsequence and representatives; the Statement is unchanged.

The Bochner form and load explicitly use the repaired L2_rho(V) definition, whose measurable-version convention governs their scalar integrals. The justifying affine-form lemma now proves precisely version-integrability with the same bounds; the all-parameter coefficient, forcing and pointwise weak equations are unchanged.

The example is scalar, so the supplier’s added d>=1 hypothesis holds with d=1. Its explicit global Hessian bounds, verified local radius and decrement threshold meet the theorem’s actual premises; the failed full step and accepted half step remain exact. Its owning contract quotation was refreshed to the examined current supplier section; the guarded item remains unchanged.

The example already explicitly assumes Countable Choice and verifies a compact operator on positive-index ell2. Its exact endpoint values d=G=2delta violate the unchanged guard, so the supplier’s added admissibility assumption does not affect the incompatible-endpoints conclusion.
